record.field: Sent to a new customer or supplier with the link to the online KYC form.

div.p: Thank you for your interest in working with aHPS.

t.p: To register you as a supplier, please complete our online registration (KYC) form. It takes about 10 minutes: company details, your contact and authorised persons, your bank details, and a copy of your certificate of incorporation, tax registration and tax compliance certificates, business license and a bank letter confirming your account.

To register you, please complete our online Know Your Customer (KYC) form. It takes about 10 minutes: company details, your contact persons, invoice and delivery addresses, and a copy of your certificate of incorporation and tax registration.

a.style: background-color: #2F5597; padding: 10px 18px; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 14px;

div.p: Once your registration is approved, we will share your supplier ID. Please quote it in your correspondence, invoices and delivery documents to us.
Once your registration is approved, we will share your customer ID, which appears on all our quotations and invoices.

Sent to a customer or supplier when their KYC is rejected, with the reason and the form link.

div.p: Thank you for submitting your registration with aHPS. Before we can approve it, we need the following correction:
Please open your form, update the information or documents, and submit it again. Your previous answers are kept.

a.style: background-color: #2F5597; padding: 10px 18px; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 14px;

record.field: Sent to a customer or supplier when their KYC is approved, with their customer or supplier ID.

div.p: We are pleased to confirm that the registration of your company with aHPS is approved.

t.p: Please quote this ID in your correspondence, invoices and delivery documents to us.
This ID appears on all our quotations and invoices. Please quote it in your purchase orders and payments to us.

div.p: If any of your company details change, please let us know so we can keep your registration up to date.
